title: Periplasmic Bacterial Expression and Purification of Elastin-like Polymers
author: Eva Rose Balog

steps.title: Transform BL21(DE3) Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Transform competent cells with plasmid DNA using heat shock.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10-100 ng plasmid (typically 1-2 μL of mini-prep DNA) with 50-100 μL BL21(DE3) competent cells in a pre-chilled Eppendorf tube on ice.
Incubate on ice for 30 min.
Heat shock at 42 ºC in a water bath for 1 min.
Allow cells to recover on ice for 2-3 min.
Add 1 mL sterile nutrient-rich liquid medium (e.g., SOC or 2XYT).
Incubate for 1 h at 37 ºC.

steps.title: Plate Transformed Cells
steps.instruction: Concentrate and plate the transformed cells for colony selection.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7000 rpm (~4600 x g) for 1 min at room temperature.
Remove all but ~50-100 μL of supernatant and resuspend the pellet in the remaining supernatant.
Pipette resuspended cells onto a 2XYT + agar + carbenicillan plate and spread using sterile glass beads.
Remove beads and store the plate at 37 ºC overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Starter and Main Cultures
steps.instruction: Grow the bacteria from the transformation plate to a large-scale culture.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 15 mL starter culture by harvesting several swipes of colonies with a sterile loop.
Add 15 μL 1000X carbenicillan.
Shake at 200 rpm at 37 ºC until visibly cloudy (typically 2-4 h).
Inoculate 1 L SuperBroth with the full volume of the starter culture.
Add 1 mL 1000X carbenicillan.
Shake at 200 rpm at 37 ºC for 24 h.

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cells and prepare them for periplasmic extraction.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells by centrifugation at 4000 rpm (~3000 x g) for 20 min at 4 ºC (pellets may be frozen at -80 ºC).
Thaw cell pellets in water and immediately transfer to ice.
Resuspend cell pellets thoroughly by pipetting and vortexing in 60 mL of ice-cold 1XPBS + 20% sucrose.
Incubate on ice for 15 min (perform resuspension rapidly in ~5 min or decrease ice time accordingly).

steps.title: Extract Periplasmic Fractions
steps.instruction: Perform sequential extractions to collect the periplasmic contents.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 7000 rpm (~4500 x g) for 10 min at 4 ºC; collect supernatant as Periplasmic Fraction 1 in a pre-chilled beaker/bottle on ice.
Resuspend the remaining pellet thoroughly by pipetting and vortexing in 40 mL cold, sterile deionized water.
Incubate on ice for 15 min (perform resuspension rapidly in ~5 min or decrease ice time accordingly).
Centrifuge at 7000 rpm (~4500 x g) for 10 min at 4 ºC; collect supernatant as Periplasmic Fraction 2.
Pool Periplasmic Fraction 1 and 2 to create the Pooled Periplasmic Fraction (expected volume ~130 mL).

steps.title: Initial ELP Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the Elastin-like Polymers (ELP) using salt.

substeps.instruction: Allow the pooled periplasmic fraction to warm to room temperature.
Add dry NaCl to a final concentration of 3 M (e.g., ~17.5 g NaCl for 100 mL); ensure NaCl is fully dissolved.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm (~17,000 x g) for 15 min at room temperature to form grey-white pellets.
Remove the supernatant (Salt Supernatant sample).

steps.title: Resuspend and Verify ELP Dissolution
steps.instruction: Recover the ELP pellet and ensure it is fully dissolved in monomer form.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellets in 15 mL ice cold, sterile 1XPBS using incubation on ice and gentle vortexing (avoid pipetting).
Confirm pellets are ELP/debris and not undissolved NaCl.
Verify ELP is fully dissolved (monomer form: brown, yellow, or translucent) and not coacervated (milky appearance). If milky, add another 15 mL cold 1XPBS.

steps.title: Perform Inverse Transition Cycling
steps.instruction: Purify the protein through repeated cycles of salt-induced precipitation and cold-spin washing.

substeps.instruction: Split the cold resuspended protein into an even number of pre-chilled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes (~1 mL per tube).
Warm tubes to room temperature and add ~100 µL 5 M NaCl per tube; mix by inversion (add another 100 µL if not cloudy).
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm (~18,000 x g) for 10 min at room temperature to form grey-white pellets.
Discard supernatants and add 600 µL cold, sterile 1XPBS to each tube.
Resuspend completely by alternating vortexing and incubating on ice, or rotating at 4 ºC (potentially overnight).
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm (~18,000 x g) for 10 min at 4 ºC to form a brown contamination pellet.
Transfer supernatants to fresh tubes (Cold Supernatant 1).
Centrifuge again at 14,000 rpm (~18,000 x g) for 10 min at 4 ºC to remove further brown contamination.
Transfer supernatants to half the number of fresh tubes by pooling two per tube (Cold Supernatant 2).
Repeat the cycling process (from adding 5 M NaCl through the cold spin) until no contamination pellet is visible, plus one additional round.

steps.title: Analyze and Store Purified Protein
steps.instruction: Verify purity and prepare the protein for long-term storage.

substeps.instruction: Analyze samples via SDS-PAGE (e.g., Periplasmic Fractions, Salt Supernatant, Cold Supernatants).
Dialyze purified protein against 4 L of pre-chilled deionized water overnight at 4 ºC.
Store dialyzed protein at -80 ºC or flash freeze in liquid nitrogen, or lyophilize for storage at -20 ºC.
